name: local-whisper-mcp
description: Transcribes audio files on your computer with Whisper, for Claude. The audio never leaves the machine.

tools.name: transcribe
tools.description: Transcribes an audio file on this computer with Whisper.

tools.name: status
tools.description: Reports the device, the models, model downloads, and the folders the server may read.

model.title: Model
model.description: Whisper model, such as large-v3-turbo-q8_0 or base. The server downloads it to ~/.local-whisper-mcp/models on first use.

language.title: Default language
language.description: Language code, such as en or es, or auto to detect it.

runtime.title: Runtime
runtime.description: auto, cpu, or vulkan. A GPU runtime that can't load falls back to the CPU.

idle_minutes.title: Idle minutes
idle_minutes.description: Minutes without calls before the model is released from memory, including GPU memory.
